contracts_rationale: Bug fix inside the charter synthesis request build; no API, schema or event contract changes. The only user-visible surface is the CLI refusal text, covered by FR-007 acceptance tests.
purpose_context: Once an operator activates any directive, the activation list includes the project directive that synthesis itself created, and every later synthesize or resynthesize refuses with a URN collision on that directive. This blocks the documented activate-then-resynthesize workflow and the implement gate that prescribes synthesis as its remedy (#6510, #4226).
purpose_tldr: Let operators re-run charter synthesis after activating directives, without it refusing on the project's own directive.
